subject: [PATCH v5 6/8] mm/gup: return a huge page's full count from follow_page_mask()

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the follow_page_mask() function in the Linux kernel's mm/gup module to return the full count of huge pages instead of just a mask. It achieves this by removing unnecessary second-grab and subpage loop calls, and clamping the returned count to the huge page's size. The patch also removes dead code related to *page_mask and __get_user_pages()'s second-grab/subpage loop. The changes are intended to improve performance and simplify the code.
